name: RM-1
description: "A bulb-type control amplifier that Vivaridge announced as a single component for the first time.Control amplifier RM-1 consists of an amplifier body RM-1 and a power supply RM-2.A semiconductor circuit is used for the power supply and control system supporting the amplifier system, and a vacuum tube is used for the amplifier element.The main circuit configuration consists of a DC amplifier configuration using a servo loop, a CR phono equalizer, an absolute phase control, and a touch-sensing mute mechanism.The audio booster consists of 12 6DJ8 (E88CC) balls.Equipped with a super sonic filter and a sub sonic filter.Mutual interference is suppressed by using a separate chassis for the power supply."

name: SYSTEM2SW-2
description: "A large speaker system created by Harold Vivaridge's 20-year research into electrostatic speakers.It is composed using an electrostatic transducer and realizes uniform diffusion of all sound ranges in phase with 180 degrees.The SYSTEM2SW-2 includes a subwoofer and a driver amplifier.The subwoofer has an independent enclosure and the amplifier system is a full bi-amp-driven system consisting of an electrostatic main unit (tube type), a subwoofer (solid state) and an electronic crossover."
